integrity.computational_scope: 47 conjugacy-class comparisons and 25 invariant-dimension checks; finite checks do not establish the infinite theorem.
integrity.scientific_review: Reconstructed proof and independently checked finite examples; external independent validation not performed.

scientific_limitations: Only rational homology and side-preserving graph automorphisms are treated.
Homology concentration and the complete-bipartite Boolean number are previously known and explicitly used.
The comparison cannot rule out unindexed or inaccessible later equivalent work.
title: The rational symmetry character of complete-bipartite Boolean complexes
